display.Wartung abgeschlossen. Gerät angehalten;: Maintenance complete. Device halted; no automatic restart.
display.Wartung angehalten. Keine weitere Löschu: Maintenance halted. No further deletion and no normal start. Review report required.

web_static.Lege zuerst ein Passwort für diese Konfi: First set a password for this configuration page.
web_static.Einmalcode vom Gerätedisplay: One-time code from the device display
web_static.Ein Clientzertifikat muss vorher auf die: A client certificate must be previously released on this device. Your browser may ask for the certificate when you log in.
web_static.Gruppen-ID (32 Hexzeichen, nur Beitritt): Group ID (32 hex characters, join only)
web_static.Gruppengeheimnis (64 Hexzeichen, nur Bei: Group secret (64 hex characters, join only)
web_static.Manuelles Datum und Uhrzeit (Europe/Berl: Manual date and time (Europe/Berlin, required without WiFi)
web_static.Diese Einrichtungsverbindung endet nach: This setup connection ends after saving. Saved WiFi profiles retain their priorities.
web_static.Dieses WLAN benötigt keinen Schlüssel: This Wi-Fi network needs no key
web_static.Bei gleicher Priorität zählt die gespeic: If the priority is the same, the saved order counts. Existing keys will never appear again; an empty key field retains the stored key.
web_static.Gespeichert wird vor einer Neuverbindung: It is saved before a new connection. The connection does not change automatically as long as it is stable. After the switch, the device address may change. If there is a typo, use the device's local recovery path.
web_static.Hochgeladene Bilder und übernommene Kata: Uploaded images and imported catalog images are stored in writable storage and are used together in the slide show.
web_static.Die mitgelieferten Katzen liegen bereits: The supplied cats are already in the shared image storage. They are protected from deletion and retained on factory reset.
web_static.Das Serverzertifikat schützt die Verbind: The server certificate protects the connection. An approved client certificate provides another way to sign in; its private key stays on your device.
web_static.Erforderlich ist ein selbstsigniertes P-: A self-signed P-256 certificate with client authentication and CA authority is required. Import the certificate and private key into your browser; upload only the public PEM certificate here. The web service restarts briefly after approval.
web_static.„Seltsam“ und „Morsecode“ sind Bedienakt: “Strange” and “Morse code” are operator actions on the display and do not save any settings.
web_static.Mitgelieferte Katzen und eigene Uploads: Supplied cats and your uploads use the same image storage. Only your uploads can be removed.
web_static.Setzt veränderbare Einstellungen und Ben: Resets changeable settings and user data to factory defaults.
web_static.In einem ausdrücklich gewählten privaten: In an explicitly selected private build, compiled private defaults are retained after the data reset.
web_static.Wenn die Kachel offen ist, drücken Sie R: If the tile is open, press RESET at the top left of the back. After restarting, the warning question appears. Only a new yes on the display deletes data.
web_static.Dieser Vorgang löscht WLAN-Profile, pers: This process deletes Wi-Fi profiles, personal runtime texts and settings, saved mesh bindings, alarm and confirmation states including history, web login and sessions, private certificate/ACME states, custom uploads, and modifiable caches.
web_static.Die Firmware und unveränderliche Standar: The firmware and unchangeable default images are retained. In an explicitly chosen private build, compiled-in private defaults remain part of the firmware; the data reset does not remove them.
web_static.Setze Nachtmodus global auf allen Geräte: Set night mode globally on all devices in the mesh
web_static.Einrichtung aktiv: Mesh pausiert. Speich: Setup active: mesh paused. Saving or leaving setup restarts normal operation.
web_static.Einrichtung verlassen und ein normaler N: Leaving setup and a normal restart do not erase data.
